run_trainer: run the grid features pre-training script with detectron2 on the visual genome dataset
build_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with attributes using the Trainer class
build_test_loader: build a detection test data loader with attributes for a specified dataset name
run_step: run a single training step that adjusts RPN and R-CNN box loss weights
setup_config: setup and configure the detectron2 config with attribute settings from a config file
